Name: Pet Against Crows
Author: stardemod
Description:
Say goodbye to your pet's idle days and hello to its newfound purpose as your ultimate crow-fighting companion! Witness your once forgettable friend transform from a simple nightly blockade on your way to bed into a fierce defender of your farm, aiding you in the battle against those pesky crows.

Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6 and multiplayer, this mod alters the crow spawning mechanics. By default, in vanilla Stardew Valley, a maximum of 4 crows can appear per day. However, with this mod, the likelihood of crow spawns decreases as your pet's friendship increases.

[list]
[*]From 0 to 249 friendship points, a maximum of 4 crows can spawn.
[*]From 250 to 499 friendship points, a maximum of 3 crows can spawn.
[*]From 500 to 749 friendship points, a maximum of 2 crows can spawn.
[*]From 750 to 999 friendship points, only 1 crow can spawn.
[*]At 1000 friendship points, the maximum possible value, no crows will spawn.
[/list]
Scarecrows still hold their value in the early and mid-game stages, providing essential protection against crows. However, once your pet's friendship maxes out, you can bid farewell to cluttering your farm with scarecrows. Of course, feel free to keep a few around for decoration purposes and to maintain that classic farm aesthetic!

Important: The mod takes effect after the first night.
